<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/pay/status/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the recorded status for a reference, self-confirming with Paystack if still pending. Intended for polling by the locker app and WhatsApp bot. `statuscode` is 00 for a known reference — the outcome is `transactionstatus`; terminal values are `success`, `failed`, `abandoned`, `reversed` (stop polling), non-terminal are `ongoing`, `pending`, `processing`, `queued`, `initialized`. No server-enforced interval: poll every ~5 s with backoff and stop on a terminal value. `paidat` is ISO 8601 UTC.
